request.rationale: Introduction rejects static weight-loss arithmetic; quantitative physiology section differentiates fat/lean energy content and partitioning. Only the limitation is activated, no group parameter is assigned to an individual.

applicability.not_reviewed: All other claims/formulas in original draft remain unreviewed.

claims.text: 这篇动态能量平衡研究说明体重变化涉及脂肪和瘦组织的不同分配，并批评忽略代谢适应的固定体重—热量换算。
claims.support_rationale: Introduction rejects static weight-loss arithmetic; quantitative physiology section differentiates fat/lean energy content and partitioning. Only the limitation is activated, no group parameter is assigned to an individual.
limitations: 体重变化本身不能确认肌肉、脂肪、水分各自变化。
该研究的肥胖与体重管理情境不自动成为力量增肌用户的个体校准。
